message: The other day, I was in the middle of a family outing when my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die. No GPS, no way to contact anyone, and I started to feel that familiar swirl of panic. Thankfully, I had a paper map in my glove compartment—an old school move, but it saved the day! It reminded me how important it is to have backups and plans that don’t rely solely on technology. Anyone else have a tech fail moment that turned into a lesson learned? 😊
